elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: Each choice serves an explicit requirement and carries a cost to validate.

elements.name: source
elements.text: Selected architecture. No measured cost savings, throughput, hardware-transfer accuracy or multi-lab reliability claim.

Choice	Value / cost or limitation
VM per lab	Guest administration and independent environment evolution; extra memory, storage and maintenance
Containerized CCs	Vendored reusable software environments; image growth, build/import cost and runtime adapters
Selective JiuwenBox reuse	Reuse compatible execution/lifecycle code; verify backend behavior and preserve OCI / VM distinctions
Shared inference API	Avoid dedicated model allocations per lab; latency, finite capacity, queues and scoped data access
Private model / fine-tuning	Control experimental model state; reserve compute and enforce no cross-lab access
Durable state and external stop	Continuity and recoverability; consistent backup, reconciliation and independent infrastructure control

elements.name: takeaway text
elements.text: Shared services address limited capacity. They do not remove the need for admission, quotas and measurement.
